travel.title: Indian Airlines Extend Saudi Suspensions, IndiGo Cancels Till November 14
travel.excerpt: Air India and Air India Express keep Riyadh and Dammam suspended till November 7 and Jeddah till October 31, while IndiGo's Saudi cancellations now run to November 14 — with refunds and one free rebooking for bookings made on or before October 24.
travel.nri_angle: Hundreds of thousands of Indian workers and Umrah travellers use these Saudi routes; the staggered suspension dates and the October 24 booking cutoff decide who gets a free rebooking or a full refund.

carousel.title: Canada Extends Work Permit Measures for Haitians and Sudanese to December 2027
carousel.excerpt: IRCC extended the temporary measures on the day they were set to expire, allowing eligible Haitian and Sudanese work permit holders in Canada to apply for extensions until December 30, 2027, with standard processing fees applying.
carousel.nri_angle: The extension shows how Canada uses temporary public-policy measures to keep workers in status, a mechanism Indian temporary residents in Canada also rely on.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Anantapur School Attack: Injured Class 10 Girl Stable After Bleeding Controlled
carousel.excerpt: Doctors at Manipal Hospital in Bengaluru have stabilised the student airlifted after Saturday's saw attack at her Rapthadu school, Education Minister Nara Lokesh said, as 20 counsellors were sent to support her classmates.
carousel.image_caption: Counsellors visit a student at home in Anantapur district after the Rapthadu school attack, with the student faces obscured. The state deployed 20 mental health counsellors to support the affected classes.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Ram Charan and Sukumar Launch RC17 as Chiranjeevi Gives the Mahurat Clap
carousel.excerpt: The Rangasthalam pair reunited at a Hyderabad pooja ceremony on Sunday for the pan-India film backed by Mythri Movie Makers and T-Series. Title, cast and release date are still under wraps.
carousel.image_caption: Ram Charan, Chiranjeevi and director Sukumar at the RC17 pooja ceremony in Hyderabad. The film, Charan and Sukumar's first collaboration since Rangasthalam, was launched on November 1.
carousel.nri_angle: A Telugu pan-India production presented by T-Series is built for simultaneous national and overseas release; US showtimes will follow once the title and date are announced.

carousel.title: India Beat Sri Lanka and Uganda to Complete Commonwealth Kabaddi Double
carousel.excerpt: India won the men's final 54-20 over Sri Lanka and the women's final 35-15 over Uganda in Ahmedabad to claim both titles at the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship.
carousel.image_caption: India and Uganda players feature on the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship 2026 highlights graphic from Ahmedabad. India won both the men's and women's titles at the championship.
carousel.nri_angle: India's double title in a home-grown sport at its first Commonwealth championship gives diaspora kabaddi fans a clear marker of the game's growing international footprint.

carousel.title: Two US Senators Give Sundar Pichai Until November 2 to Answer on Classroom AI
carousel.excerpt: Josh Hawley and Richard Blumenthal have put nine questions to Google's chief executive about Gemini in schools, citing cases of students who leaned on AI for homework and emotional support.
carousel.image_caption: Senators Josh Hawley and Richard Blumenthal at a Senate hearing in Washington. The pair wrote to Google CEO Sundar Pichai on October 21, demanding answers on AI in classrooms by November 2.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-American families are heavy users of US public schools and Chromebooks; the senators' questions on default-on AI and opt-outs affect their children directly.

carousel.title: India's Rs 1.64 Lakh Crore Chip Bet Now Has 12 Projects — and Its First Production Lines
carousel.excerpt: Twelve approved semiconductor projects span six states, Gujarat holds the largest share, and Micron, Kaynes and CG Semi have started commercial production under Semicon 2.0's Rs 1.275 lakh crore outlay.
carousel.nri_angle: For diaspora investors, the investable story is the listed ecosystem around the fabs — equipment, materials, packaging and design — rather than the unlisted project vehicles themselves.
